Business / Delivery workforce

Staff the shift.
Support the rider.

Opening a new dispatch point or covering a recurring shift? Qwikserve works from the hub requirement through rider onboarding and the weekly pay cycle.

Discuss your requirement ↗
01 / The hub brief

What goes into a staffing plan?

Two stores in the same city can have very different peaks. Give us the operating pattern at each one.

  1. 01
    Location

    Name each reporting point

    Share the store or hub, the area it serves and the person riders should report to.

  2. 02
    Roster

    Separate regular shifts from peaks

    List days, reporting times and how many people you need on each shift. Flag a launch date, weekend peak or seasonal requirement separately.

  3. 03
    Vehicles

    Estimate the vehicle mix

    Tell us how many riders may need a rental EV so the field team can check options against local availability.

02 / In the field

From shortlist
to first shift.

The recruiter and the hub contact each have a part to play before a rider starts.

QWIKSERVE FIELD TEAM

Screen & onboard

Discuss the role and location with riders, verify the required records and link the rider to the company assignment.

HUB CONTACT

Confirm reporting

Confirm who is expected, where riders should arrive and the timing of the first dispatch. Flag changes before the shift starts.

OPERATIONS TEAM

Connect the records

Keep the rider’s company IDs and vehicle assignment together so earnings can be matched to the right person later.

03 / Weekly reconciliation

What happens
on payday?

The company paysheet starts the process. A bank transfer result closes the loop.

  1. 01
    Earnings

    Match the company paysheet

    The office matches weekly gross earnings to the rider’s company ID and the relevant pay period.

  2. 02
    Deductions

    Check rent, dues and holds

    Rental days are tied to the EV assignment. Outstanding dues and cash-on-delivery holds are checked before the transfer amount is prepared.

  3. 03
    Transfer

    Check the bank result

    The team prepares payment instructions and compares them with the bank’s report. A failed transfer can be followed up separately.
